zh.text: 若甲國和乙國均作完全專門化生產並與對方進行貿易，兩國的總產量會有所增加：物品X增加______單位，而物品Y增加______單位。
香港中學文憑考試 2020 卷一 第 42 題

en.text: Both Country A and Country B produce only toys and computers. The table below shows the amount of inputs required by Country A and Country B in the production of toys and computers.

zh.text: 甲、乙兩國只生產玩具和電腦。下表顯示甲、乙兩國生產玩具和電腦所需的投入數量。

en.text: Based on the above information, which of the following statements is correct?

zh.text: 根據以上資料，下列哪項陳述是正確的？

en.text: Country A has an absolute advantage in the production of computers over Country B.

zh.text: 相對乙國，甲國生產電腦有絕對優勢。

en.text: Country B has no comparative advantage in producing any goods as its opportunity cost of producing toys equals that of producing computers.

zh.text: 乙國生產兩種物品均沒有比較優勢，因為它生產玩具的機會成本與生產電腦的相等。

en.text: If a transportation cost of 1 unit of computers is required to trade 1 unit of toys, it is impossible to have mutually beneficial trade.

zh.text: 若交易1單位玩具需要1單位的電腦作為運輸費用，則互利貿易沒有可能出現。

en.text: It is impossible to have mutually beneficial trade as the two countries have equal productivity in producing toys.

zh.text: 由於該兩國生產玩具的生產力相等，所以沒有可能出現互利貿易。

en.text: The following table shows the amount of apples or peaches that Country A and Country B can produce with one unit of resources.

zh.text: 下表顯示甲國和乙國以一單位的資源可生產的蘋果或桃子數量。

en.text: According to the above table, which of the following statements are correct?

zh.text: 根據上表，下列哪些陳述是正確的？

en.text: The opportunity cost of producing 1 unit of apples is 0.8 units of peaches in Country A.

zh.text: 甲國生產 1 單位蘋果的機會成本是 0.8 單位桃子。

en.text: Country B has an absolute advantage in producing apples.

zh.text: 乙國生產蘋果有絕對優勢。

en.text: A mutually beneficial terms of trade can be 1 unit of apples = 0.7 units of peaches.

zh.text: 一個互惠互利的貿易比率可以是 1 單位蘋果 = 0.7 單位桃子。

zh.text: 假設 X 國和 Y 國都是分配一半資源生產成衣，而另一半資源則生產玩具。他們的產出總量如下：

en.text: Based on the above information, which of the following is/are correct?

zh.text: 根據以上資料，下列哪項／些是正確的？

en.text: Country Y enjoys an absolute advantage in producing clothing.

zh.text: Y 國在生產成衣方面享有絕對優勢。

en.text: Country Y enjoys a comparative advantage in producing clothing.

zh.text: Y 國在生產成衣方面享有比較優勢。

en.text: If the transportation cost for importing each unit of clothing is 4 units of toys, mutually beneficial trade is still possible between the two countries.

zh.text: 若進口每單位成衣的運輸成本是 4 單位玩具，兩國之間仍可能出現互利貿易。

en.text: Country A employs labour to produce good X and good Y. Its labour input requirements for the production of one unit of good X and good Y are 1 man-hour and 2 man-hours respectively.

zh.text: A國僱用勞工生產物品X和物品Y。其生產一單位物品X和物品Y的勞工投入量分別為1人時及2人時。

en.text: Based on the above information, which of the following statements is correct?

zh.text: 根據以上資料，下列哪項陳述是正確的？

en.text: Country A will specialise in producing good X because it can produce more units of good X per unit of labour.

zh.text: A國會專門生產物品X，因為它每單位勞工能生產較多單位的物品X。

en.text: Country A will export good X because it has a lower opportunity cost in producing good X than good Y.

zh.text: A國會出口物品X，因為它生產物品X的機會成本較生產物品Y低。

en.text: If the terms of trade is 1 unit of good X equals 1 unit of good Y, Country A will gain 1 unit of good X per unit of its imports.

zh.text: 若貿易比率為1單位物品X等於1單位物品Y，A國每單位入口可賺取1單位物品X。

en.text: If the terms of trade is 1 unit of good X equals 1 unit of good Y, Country A will gain 1 unit of good Y per unit of its exports.

zh.text: 若貿易比率為1單位物品X等於1單位物品Y，A國每單位出口可賺取1單位物品Y。
